shared_elements: repeated small rounded units used as texture/filler (fleece curls vs. petal bosses)
justification: A shows a narrative procession of bearded human figures leading horned rams in profile, while B is a purely geometric radiating rosette-disc of concentric rings, petal-like lobes and a toothed rim; there is no shared creature, object or symbol. The only faint commonality is relief carving with repeated small rounded units as surface texture, which is far too generic to suggest a shared iconographic scheme.
